component.name: Glacier Player
component.summary: Glacier Player — a COSMIC desktop applet for QQ Music

description.p: Stream QQ Music from your COSMIC panel. Choose audio quality, browse your library and artists, search tracks, and use desktop media keys.

ul.li: Selectable MP3, FLAC, and Hi-Res audio quality
Library — playlists, albums, favorites, and local history
Track search, artist pages, and time-synced lyrics
MPRIS integration — media keys, playerctl, KDE Connect
Secure QQ or WeChat QR login with system keyring storage
Runs as a COSMIC panel applet or a standalone window

screenshot.caption: Panel applet with library collection and now-playing bar
Standalone window showing album detail view
